title: Meta Launches $1,299 VR Headset That Look Like Glasses to Rival Apple Vision Pro
description: Meta Platforms Inc. on Wednesday launched $1,299 virtual-reality glasses that undercut Apple Inc. in price and size while putting its headset line on track for profitability.

title: Meta Debuts $349 Camera-Free Ray-Bans and Brings Muse to Glasses
description: Meta Platforms Inc. is expanding its smart-glasses lineup with camera-free models, support for the popular new Muse assistant and a hearing-aid mode.

title: Revolut Is Bringing Facial-Recognition Checkout to UK Businesses
description: Revolut Ltd. is piloting a new point-of-sale system in the UK that will let customers make in-store payments using their faces, as it pushes to bank more businesses.
